functions.description: SHA-1 block transform over hash context
functions.notes: Target is speed-built library SHA-1: native ror operands (add r2,r2,r3,ror #27; and r4,r7,r4,ror #24), loop-invariant constants hoisted into r7/r8, length spilled to stack. Project compiler emits lsr/orr pairs and reloads constants, so 0x2e8 vs 0x280 regardless of source form. Tried: inline mask, k1 local, for-loops, while((len-=0x40)>0), swapped rotate operand order, colorsweep --apply (only a cast trick, reverted). No reduction in 9 runs.
